_comment: ISC-141: a stale agent_start reaches the supervisor BEFORE the ack of the prompt that allocated the live epoch. That is the only region of the stream in which EpochManager.attribute can answer `prior` for a live epoch — everything after the ack has a higher seq by construction, because RpcClient dispatches records in order and synchronously. bindStart must refuse to open epoch 2's window on it, and the REAL agent_start that follows the ack must open it: without that second half the scenario is satisfied by a fence that refuses everything.
